fields.value: Chatbot (Retrieval Augmentation Generation) GenAI: - Working in utilizing GenAI for Retrieval Augmentation Generation (RAG) within the Semiconductor sector, I led the successful execution of end-to-end RAG architecture to overcome specific business challenges. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, Faiss, Langchain, and employing techniques like Prompt Engineering, chunking methods, and pre-processing, I ensured the seamless integration of advanced tools. Additionally, I utilized Azure durable function, Azure Webapp, and Rest API to enhance functionality and provide efficient solutions.

fields.value: Knowledge Search (Question & Answer) GenAI: - Implemented a knowledge search(Q&A) system for client by leveraging GPT3, GPT3.5, and GPT4 models. Applied azure form recognizer to ensure precise information extraction and developed pre-processing pipeline for efficient data storage and chunking. Applied prompt engineering with few shots to classify diverse query types so to extract relevant chunk from Redis database and to find best utilized chunks and their metadata to generate context of utilized chunks. Integrated a structured data pipeline to fetch details from snowflake database by generating snowflake query with the help of prompts. Implemented article and summary generation, showcase business Insights by using research and news documents. Limit the model to provide any sensitive information or personal information and connected the user interface with a Rest API for seamless data exchange.

fields.value: Online Retail Analysis The project focuses on analyzing online retail data to enhance business performance and customer experience. We worked with datasets that included orders, customers, sellers, products, and customer reviews. fields.value: Store Data Management using Tableau: - This project involved using Tableau to create an interactive dashboard for managing store data, including sales, inventory, and customer behavior.
